motive.zhHans: 为了不让血溅到自己身上，他用卫生纸缠住手臂，并把卫生纸卷套在刀上，以限制飞溅的血量，再把刀指向服部平次和柯南，所以他们身上才沾到了血。此事被保密，因为一旦曝光，就会给由衣的父亲——一名国会议员——带来断送其政治生涯的灾难，因为他有了私生子。服部平次之所以查明真相，是因为 Momiji 命令 Iori 透露的提示，而且她在 Anzai 被刺时还听到了窥视孔上胶带的刮擦声。
motive.en: To avoid getting blood on himself, he wrapped his arm around toilet paper and put the toilet paper's roll around the knife to limit the quantity of blood to splatter and directed the knife towards Heiji and Conan so that was why they got blood on themselves. This was kept a secret because it would cause a career-ending disaster for Yui's father, who is a dietman, for having fathered a lovechild. Heiji found the truth because of the hint Momiji ordered Iori to reveal and she also heard a scratch of the tape on the peephole when Anzai was stabbed.

method.zhHans: 他出于嫉妒对方与自己女朋友走得太近而刺杀了被害人。他透过窥视孔看的诀窍是在窥视孔上贴胶带，把磨砂玻璃的表面压平以便看清。他还在自己家里、在戏剧社的活动室里练习在黑暗中刺击，甚至在笔记本上画下了波洛咖啡馆现场的草图。服部平次之所以查明真相，是因为 Momiji 命令 Iori 透露的提示，而且她在 Anzai 被刺时还听到了窥视孔上胶带的刮擦声。由衣揭露真相后，Ozumi 放声大哭，并接到了 Anzai 打来的电话，对方告诉他被刺的时候很痛。在漫画中，高木涉告诉目暮警部，最近的一起案件中犯人用萝卜让血迹消失了。
method.en: He stabbed the victim out of jealously that he was too close to his girlfriend. The trick he used to see through the peephole was to put tape on it to flatten the surface of the frosted glass to see. He also practiced himself in his house to stab in the dark at his drama club's room and even drew sketches of the setting in cafe Poirot in his notebook. Heiji found the truth because of the hint Momiji ordered Iori to reveal and she also heard a scratch of the tape on the peephole when Anzai was stabbed. After Yui revealed the truth, Ozumi bursts into tears and receives a phone call from Anzai that told him that it hurt when he stabbed him. In the manga, Takagi tells Inspector Megure that, in a recent case, the culprit had used daikon to make blood disappear.

After Yui revealed the truth, Ozumi bursts into tears and receives a phone call from Anzai that told him that it hurt when he stabbed him. Aftermath It's revealed that 'Shinichi Wada' is actually Muga Iori, the butler of Momiji Ooka's family. He mentions to Momiji that while Heiji is interested in another girl, it shouldn't prove a problem for Momiji.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Meisuke Ozumi。他出于嫉妒对方与自己女朋友走得太近而刺杀了被害人。他透过窥视孔看的诀窍是在窥视孔上贴胶带，把磨砂玻璃的表面压平以便看清。他还在自己家里、在戏剧社的活动室里练习在黑暗中刺击，甚至在笔记本上画下了波洛咖啡馆现场的草图。为了不让血溅到自己身上，他用卫生纸缠住手臂，并把卫生纸卷套在刀上，以限制飞溅的血量，再把刀指向服部平次和柯南，所以他们身上才沾到了血。开灯之前，他把卫生纸冲掉，把纸卷放回原处，并取下窥视孔上的胶带。Amuro 说那个卫生纸卷有点奇怪，像是被强行装上去过。真相是 Tengo 其实是 Ozumi 的女朋友由衣同父异母的兄弟姐妹。被害人 Tengo 甚至录下了给 Ozumi 的生日祝福，说明了他与由衣关系的真相。此事被保密，因为一旦曝光，就会给由衣的父亲——一名国会议员——带来断送其政治生涯的灾难，因为他有了私生子。服部平次之所以查明真相，是因为 Momiji 命令 Iori 透露的提示，而且她在 Anzai 被刺时还听到了窥视孔上胶带的刮擦声。由衣揭露真相后，Ozumi 放声大哭，并接到了 Anzai 打来的电话，对方告诉他被刺的时候很痛。
resolution.en: The culprit is Meisuke Ozumi. He stabbed the victim out of jealously that he was too close to his girlfriend. The trick he used to see through the peephole was to put tape on it to flatten the surface of the frosted glass to see. He also practiced himself in his house to stab in the dark at his drama club's room and even drew sketches of the setting in cafe Poirot in his notebook. To avoid getting blood on himself, he wrapped his arm around toilet paper and put the toilet paper's roll around the knife to limit the quantity of blood to splatter and directed the knife towards Heiji and Conan so that was why they got blood on themselves. Before the lights opened, he flushed the toilet paper, put the roll to its place back and retrieved the tape on the peephole. Amuro remarked that the toilet paper roll was a bit odd and seemed to have been forced. The truth is that Tengo is actually the half-sibling of Ozumi's girlfriend Yui. The victim, Tengo, even recorded a birthday message for Ozumi telling the truth about his relationship with Yui. This was kept a secret because it would cause a career-ending disaster for Yui's father, who is a dietman, for having fathered a lovechild. Heiji found the truth because of the hint Momiji ordered Iori to reveal and she also heard a scratch of the tape on the peephole when Anzai was stabbed. After Yui revealed the truth, Ozumi bursts into tears and receives a phone call from Anzai that told him that it hurt when he stabbed him.
